progress.text: (M14, #3373): The main menu and its long submenus scroll in short windows, keeping their commands reachable. Estimates unchanged.
(M3, #3387): Save-prompt shortcuts yield to later consent and utility dialogs; a synthetic UI regression checks that an edited document stays open. Estimates unchanged.

(M3, #3360): Switching between Read and the docking workspace retains the current document’s scroll position at fixed zoom, including within-page position; separate tabs retain their own offsets. Estimates unchanged.

(M7, tracked text): Editable paragraphs and object labels distinguish repeated glyph tracking from word gaps in TJ arrays and separately positioned glyphs. Synthetic regressions cover character spacing, horizontal scaling, rotated baselines, larger word gaps, and rows of one-glyph words or cells (inferred tracking is capped at half an em, so a b c and digit or Y/N columns keep their spaces). Estimates unchanged.

(M12, XFA, #2574): The Acrobat observations behind the line above were first made on a public real-world form, which the Privacy rule does not allow; they are replaced by ones made on a synthetic form (three breakBefore pageArea sections, then a page area with occur min="1" max="1", with and without relevant="-print"). Acrobat Pro shows the closing page last in both and prints it in both, blank only with relevant="-print": confirmed. The synthetic form also shows a difference not fixed yet: Acrobat opens it as 5 pages, with an empty first body page before the first section, where PdfCraft lays out 4. Two more synthetic forms narrow it down: with breakBefore targetType="pageArea" on the first section, with or without startNew, Acrobat opens an empty body page first; without a break on the first section it lays out 4, as PdfCraft does (so startNew is not the cause). Not fixed yet: layout.rs skips a break while the page is still empty. Estimates unchanged.

(M10, #3120): Export to Word, PowerPoint, HTML and RTF reads text from form XObjects nested as deep as the renderer draws them (50 levels), and up to 50 000 forms a page (the renderer's budget for nested ones); it stopped at 12 levels and 4 096 forms and left the rest out silently. A page past those limits is listed in docexportoffice's truncatedpages, with a warning. Estimates unchanged.

(M5, PR #1971 review): Nested FDF annotation values that identify a source /Page or /Pages dictionary become null at every copy depth. A synthetic three-page PDF saved and reopened before export verifies that destination actions cannot pull source page content into the FDF, while unrelated nested metadata and shared references remain intact. FDF import semantics, copied-graph limits and estimates are unchanged.

(M6, #2892): Push-button normal labels are editable per widget through Options and formsetprops, independently of field names; rendering, undo/redo and incremental/full save/reopen are covered. Estimates unchanged.
(M7, #3212): Headers, Bates numbers, watermarks and added text stay visible after unfinished marked content, with original content preserved.

(M4, PR #1919 review): repeated page indices apply each rotation to the latest page-local value, preserving indirect/inherited angles. Synthetic adjacent/interleaved duplicates retain siblings and page contents through incremental and full saves. Estimates unchanged.

(M3, #3149): Page replacement cancels render demand collected for the previous geometry; all viewer raster upload paths reject empty or oversized textures before cache eviction. Synthetic regressions reproduce the reported 1880×2350 upload at a 2048 limit, retain cached images and unsaved edits, and resume bounded backdrops and tiles. Estimates unchanged.

(M8, #1350): Integrated current main while preserving content-stream comment boundaries. Hidden-text cleanup retires unused named replacement descriptions on rewritten pages and forms, including inherited/shared resource holders, without removing descriptions still used by surviving content. Synthetic saved-byte and preservation regressions cover the cleanup. Estimates unchanged.

(M4, #2997): Dragging page thumbnails in the Organize grid with Ctrl held (Option on macOS) drops copies at the gap instead of moving the pages: a "+" badge sits by the pointer, the copies land at the gap selected, and one undo step ("Duplicate pages") takes them out again. pageduplicate takes at (1-based, where the first copy goes; left out, after the last of them) so agents can drive the same thing, and the UI control channel's ui.drag modifiers now reach gestures that read the input state. Estimates unchanged.

(M3, #2781): The Pages panel follows the current page, as Acrobat's page thumbnails do: going to a page whose thumbnail is out of sight (scrolling, Page Down, Go to page, a bookmark) scrolls the panel just enough to show it. A thumbnail already in view, or clicked, leaves the panel where it is, and a page change while the user scrolls the panel or drags thumbnails does not move it. Estimates unchanged.

(M12, #1645): CLI info, text and render use the engine's dynamic XFA layout rather than placeholder pages. Synthetic two-page and encrypted-form regressions cover counts, text, pixels, copy permissions and unchanged input bytes. Estimates unchanged.

(M10, #1201 partial): Lossless image export applies each component's Decode pair. Indexed values round and clip before palette lookup. Color-key masks keep raw samples. The existing 16-bit precision limit remains. JPEG and mask Decode, ICC transforms, and calibrated colors remain outside this fix. Estimates unchanged.
(M3, #2739): Wrapped revision buttons stay above Binding in Document Properties. A synthetic regression checks control bounds and opens a saved revision at two viewport widths. Estimates unchanged.

(M5, PR #1971 refresh): Nested FDF annotation values retain shared or cyclic copied graphs. Discovery borrows direct values and records annotation positions with lazy array owners; retained entries are budgeted before cloning. Synthetic stress fixtures include repeated aliases and saved-PDF cache eviction. Limits cover the copied graph; source parsing and page discovery retain their existing limits, with no total source-memory bound. FDF import semantics and estimates are unchanged.

(M7, Edit text caret): In a text region that mixes sizes (a 24 pt title over 12 pt lines), the inline editor's caret on a small row was as tall as the region's first size and reached into the row below: egui draws the caret at least one row of the text field's font tall, and that font had the paragraph's first size. The field's font is now half the region's smallest size, so each row's own height decides. Kittest regression; checked in the app on a real document. Estimates unchanged.

(M4, #1919 refresh): Integrated upstream 99941daa while retaining the indirect page rotation correction and all upstream progress. Only independent documentation conflicts required resolution; focused production and test files are unchanged from the previously green CI head. Estimates unchanged.

(M6, AcroForm XML text): Plain AcroForm XML imports retain all direct text around comments and processing instructions, including CDATA and character references. Synthetic regressions verify exact values and unknown catalog data after incremental and full save/reopen. Nested-element and XFA interpretation are unchanged. Estimates unchanged.

(M6, #1917 refresh): Integrated upstream 99941daa while retaining the XML/XFDF attribute whitespace correction and all upstream progress. Only independent documentation conflicts required resolution; focused production and test files are unchanged from the previously green CI head. Estimates unchanged.

(M1, #2267 refresh): Integrated upstream 99941daa while retaining the raw-deflate fallback correction and all upstream progress. Only independent documentation conflicts required resolution; focused production and test files are unchanged from the previously green CI head. Estimates unchanged.

(M2, gap 12): cargo xtask text-oracle scores reading order as well as word F1: the longest common subsequence of the two word sequences over the longer one. F1 is a bag of words and cannot see order at all -- measuring #2431, a change that moves text and nothing else, it called 26 of the 29 files whose output changed identical, where the order score separated 18 improvements from 6 regressions. Reports, does not gate; a disagreement with Poppler, not a verdict. Estimates unchanged.

(M2, #2305 follow-up): WinAnsiEncoding 0xA0 and 0xAD and MacRomanEncoding 0xCA extract as the ordinary space and hyphen Annex D.2 names them, in the vendored hayro tables (patch 30) as well as crates/fonts, so search, copy and redaction see characters that were hidden behind U+00A0 and U+00AD. Across the pdf.js corpus the soft hyphens we extract fall 117 to 13 and the non-breaking spaces 30 to 26; the rest come from /ToUnicode. An explicit /Differences name keeps its glyph list value, as pdftotext does. Estimates unchanged.

(M12, XFA, #2574): A pageArea with no <occur> repeats without limit instead of taking a subform's default of one use, so a later page area with occur max="1" is no longer drawn (with a copy of its fields) over every body page. A page area's occur min is honoured too: one the body never reached gets the pages it still needs after the body (the once-only closing page of a form, with its button, comes last). Acrobat Pro also puts that page last, and when printing keeps it but leaves it blank (relevant="-print" on the page area), which PdfCraft does not do yet; both re-observed on a synthetic fixture, see the 2026-10-19 line. Synthetic regression tests. Estimates unchanged.

(M8, #2447): Removing links or comments (Remove Hidden Information, Sanitize) also drops the tagged-PDF structure tree's object references to them, so the full rewrite no longer keeps a removed link's URL or a comment's text. Regression seen to fail without the fix. Estimates unchanged.

(M6, CSV tab-containing headers): CSV export and spreadsheet merging quote tabs, and import distinguishes quoted tabs from TSV delimiters without changing field identities. Synthetic export/import and incremental/full save regressions cover header tabs, quotes and line breaks, plus ordinary TSV controls. Formula-cell policy is unchanged. Estimates unchanged.

(M6, AcroForm XML text): Plain AcroForm XML imports retain all direct text around comments and processing instructions, including CDATA and character references. Synthetic regressions verify exact values and unknown catalog data after incremental and full save/reopen. Nested-element and XFA interpretation are unchanged. Estimates unchanged.

(M12, XFA, #2574): A pageArea with no <occur> repeats without limit instead of taking a subform's default of one use, so a later page area with occur max="1" is no longer drawn (with a copy of its fields) over every body page. Synthetic regression test; the page area's occur min (a once-only page of its own) is still not laid out, recorded in form.xfa-dynamic. Estimates unchanged.

(M14, #2383 candidate): Device-limit requests now clamp unsupported maxima and minimum alignments before enabling the adapter's full 2D texture extent. This addresses the reported V3D request of 16 shader variables on an adapter supporting 15. Synthetic regressions fail before the clamp and pass afterward, along with the existing HiDPI case and Windows GPU-required application tests. Raspberry Pi startup remains unverified; milestone and overall estimates are unchanged.

(M2, large object streams): An object stream's index of objnum offset pairs is read once per stream instead of once per object fetched from it (vendored hayro-syntax patch 22), so reading every object of a stream of N objects no longer takes N² steps. A Firefox page whose 65,542 objects share one stream (pdf.js corpus bug1978317.pdf) drew in 37 s and extracted its text in 40 s; it now takes 0.5 s and 1.9 s, and leaves the robustness baseline's known timeouts. 40,000 pages in one stream open in 0.2 s instead of 54 s. The regression fails before the fix. Estimates unchanged.

(M14, gap 24): misc.localization and misc.installers move from planned to partial. Localization: 22 catalogs ship, but Chinese shows tofu in releases, Telugu has no release font and Arabic is not mirrored. Installers: macOS and Windows releases are signed, Linux packages are not. The Acrobat menu diff itself remains open. Estimates unchanged.

(M14, PNG export): Export ▸ Image as PNG, pdfcraft-cli render and the pagerender automation/MCP tool write an opaque page as RGB at deflate level 3 instead of RGBA at the default level 6: the files stay the same size and are written 3–5× faster (a 300-dpi scan drawn at 220 dpi: 805 → 167 ms; a text page at 220 dpi: 70 → 40 ms; an annual-report page at 150 dpi: 179 → 64 ms). A page with translucent pixels is still written as RGBA. The automation tools use the engine's encoder instead of a copy of it. Estimates unchanged.

(M2, renderer speed): Three vendored hayro-interpret patches (31–33), pixel for pixel the same over the first three pages of every pdf.js corpus file. A sampled (Type 0) function keeps its samples in one flat array instead of a hash map rebuilt every time a shading using it is painted: bug1721218 (InDesign) draws in 0.49 s (was 1.34 s), and a 2,097,152-sample ramp painted 30 times in under a second (was 38 s). One decode of a JPEG or Flate image serves every size it is drawn at (only JPX decodes for a size), so zooming a 300-dpi scan in and out costs 35–40% less render work. Coons and tensor patch meshes copy their vertices' colours less: mesh-gradient pages draw 10–16% faster (page 8 of #1584's annual report 773 → 696 ms). Estimates unchanged.

(M3, #2166 part 1): Save asks before writing over a version of the file the document did not come from (something else wrote it since the open or the last save), with Save as… to keep it, and the changed-on-disk notice says what Reload and Save each do; a file that is open already comes to the front instead of opening twice; a running instance's autosaves are locked, so a second instance neither offers nor discards them. Part 2 (every writer checked and atomic) is #2182.

(M9, #1895): Preserve original signature artwork and show validation through a separate page overlay. Generic in-place appearance rewriting is deferred: neither a caption substring nor a unique drawing establishes an icon role. Signed regressions cover chamfered borders, mixed signer/caption text, image/text exports, both print modes and saves. Snapshot reuse and trust/cache refresh remain. Baked Not Verified captions are not replaced; #79 remains open. Estimates unchanged.

(M1, Flate fallback): Raw deflate whose first bytes resemble a zlib header no longer loses a decoding-limit error during fallback. Strict and tolerant filter regressions and a COS stream regression cover refusal at the caller limit and successful decoding within it. No parity status or estimate changes.

(M14, Italian catalog): Italian gains the 201 entries the other catalogs had and the code looks up: the sentences the accessibility checker, preflight, signature validation and page-range parser word, certificate and calendar labels, digital-ID dialog messages and five plurals. It now has 2,528 entries. 64 keys other catalogs carry but no code looks up (tooltip texts with a fixed shortcut, older wordings, generic labels only Lithuanian has) were left out. AI-assisted, written from the meaning of the English; native review welcome. Estimates unchanged.

(M1, #2166): No PDF leaves the engine unchecked and no writer truncates: new files from Combine, Extract, Split and Create, signed, timestamped and LTV-embedded files and the OCR batch output reopen with their pages before anyone writes them, as saves already did; the desktop app, the automation tools (with or without --root) and the CLI's edit, combine, extract and split all write through the one staging-file writer in pdfcraft-platform, so a failed write or --out naming the input never leaves a half-written file. Special files such as /dev/stdout are still written as given.
